_note: Gear: upgrades to adventuring, bought with xp on the adventures tab's upgrades page (scripts/adventure/gear.gd, GameState.buy_gear). Listed in path order: the crayon road snakes through them in this order. A sticker shows once its 'after' has a level and its 'needs' (an unlock or location id) is open; boots and tote show from the start. The next level costs 'xp' x 'grow' ^ level. 'each' is what one level adds to a value; a value is 'base' (0 when not listed) plus every level's 'each'. 'show' is how the effect reads on the page: {key} prints the value, {key%} prints it x100 ('show_parts' once parts are open). Gear is packed when a trip sets off (your trips, your pet's auto parties and the workers'), never for dungeons. Keys: walk (trips shorter by this share), coins (trip coins x 1 + this), treat_every / treat_zoom (seconds between treats / seconds a treat zooms), pickups (trail coins and xp x 1 + this), streak_max (most a trail streak multiplies), bits (each bit in the treat bag rolls again for one more at this chance), part_x (trail part weight x this, once parts are open), luck (added to the chance of options whose failure hurts or loses), saves (a solo pet that would be lost stays hurt, this many times a trip), save_share (in a party, the chance each such pet is saved), harm (hurt, injured and lost counts x 1 - this). Prices are placeholders until the A1 pacing sim.
